async def run(items, read):
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        if saved is None:
            saved = await read()
    for item in items:
        row = cache.get(item)
        if row is None:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            row = await read(item)
    for item in items:
        saved = None
        if saved is None:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            saved = await read(item)
    for group in items:
        local = None
        for item in group:
            if local is None:
                # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
                local = await read(item)
async def reset_by_await(items, read):
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        saved = await refresh(item)
        if saved is None:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            saved = await read(item)

async def unrelated_reset(items, read):
    saved = None
    for item in items:
        count = item
        if saved is None:
            saved = await read()
